title: Python
excerpt: stoke handles Python projects with venv creation, dependency installation, and syntax checking.

title: Java
excerpt: stoke handles Java projects with JDK detection, incremental compilation, and Maven dependency management.

title: C / C++
excerpt: stoke handles C and C++ projects with header dependency tracking, parallel compilation, build profiles, and vcpkg integration.

title: Go
excerpt: stoke supports Go projects using the standard go build and go run tooling.

title: Rust
excerpt: stoke supports Rust projects using the standard cargo build and cargo run tooling.

title: Kotlin
excerpt: stoke supports Kotlin projects by delegating to Gradle (via the project's Gradle Wrapper, or a system-installed gradle).

title: C
excerpt: stoke supports C# projects using the standard dotnet build and dotnet run tooling.

title: Ruby
excerpt: stoke supports Ruby projects using the Ruby interpreter and Bundler.

title: PHP
excerpt: stoke supports PHP projects using the PHP interpreter and Composer.

title: JavaScript
excerpt: stoke supports JavaScript projects using Node.js runtime.

title: TypeScript
excerpt: stoke supports TypeScript projects using tsx runtime (no compilation step).
